note: THE FREE-STACK ROSTER (2026-09-30). One row per source; read by research/free_stack_hunter.py every hour. terms_evidence.terms_quote: 在遵守中国有关法律与本声明的前提下，任何机构或者个人可基于非商业目的浏览、下载本网站的内容。 / 未经上海期货交易所书面许可，任何机构或者个人不得以向他人出售牟利为目的，使用本网站的任何内容，此种使用包括但不限于拷贝、下载、存贮、通过硬拷贝或电子抓取系统、发送、转换、出租、演示、转载、复制、修改、销售、传播、出版或任何其它形式的散发。
terms_evidence.reading: the grant is NON-COMMERCIAL browse/download only (基于非商业目的浏览、下载); a trading desk's use of the data to trade is commercial use, which the statement does not grant, so terms are REFUSED (fail closed; audit of PR #224, 2026-10-06). A flip needs SHFE's written permission (书面许可) recorded here

sources.mechanism: SHFE top-20 member crowding, state-broker net positioning, warehouse-receipt draws and curve shape are physical-and-positioning states of China's metal demand that price-only families on XAU/XAG/XCU/XAL/XZN/XNI/AUD cannot see
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: member rankings mix hedgers and speculators under one broker name and warrants move with delivery logistics and bonded-zone arbitrage, so the signal should fail around delivery months and import-window openings rather than on Western macro days

sources.mechanism: top-20 net short on IF/IH/IC/IM (the CITIC-led hedge book) is a known China equity-risk state transmitted to CHINAH / HK50 / USDCNH; bond-futures positioning carries the onshore rates state to USDCNH
sources.failure_mode_hypothesis: the index-futures net short is largely structural hedging of quant and snowball books, so it should fail when hedging demand, not view, moves (snowball knock-ins, quant de-grossing)
sources.cursor: newest / oldest trading day held + retry list; forward from newest, then backfill walk to backfill_days weekdays; a per-day file is a vintage, never an overwrite
sources.blocker_prior: BLOCKED_ON_TERMS until `terms` is confirmed; the build sandbox's proxy refuses every exchange host, so the parsers are proven on fixtures in the documented formats (desks/mt5/tests/fixtures/free_stack/cnx/README.md) and the live yield is UNMEASURED until the box runs it
